name: overnight_gap_reversion_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with a 0.3-1.0% gap vs the previous close, the gap is produced by SGX Nifty futures and thin pre-market participation rather than genuine intraday price discovery. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks (domestic MFs, FIIs) receive fill prices materially worse than their expected intraday VWAP at the open and immediately initiate counter-directional orders to exploit the mispricing, creating a systematic directional flow toward the gap fill within the first 20-30 minutes. At 5-second resolution we detect when the short-term RSI signals exhaustion of the opening spike (RSI below 40 for gap-down, above 60 for gap-up) and price is still away from session VWAP, then enter in the direction of the institutional reversion pressure to capture the next 30-120 second leg of this flow.
core_signal_oneliner: Moderate overnight gap (0.3-1.0%) reversion trade triggered by 1-min RSI exhaustion of the opening gap-direction thrust within 09:20-09:50 window
